rules.name: PostgreSQL — Privilege Escalation via SET ROLE
rules.description: Detects PostgreSQL SET ROLE attempts for privilege escalation
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
postgresql_events
| where postgresql has_any("database", "postgresql", "privilege-escalation", "sql")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold
